Write the hypothesis and planned method BEFORE running the experiment.
Finish with actual observations; check the four confirmations only when true.
Negative/inconclusive results can pass. Missing evidence cannot.
Duplicate the complete Experiment block with a unique ID for each attempt.
Mixed results/performance work needs separate blocks.
For non-experimental work only, replace the block with the maintenance declaration
in governance/README.md. Do not invent an experiment.
-->

### Completion checklist

- [ ] Hypothesis: the claim and decision criterion are explicit.
- [ ] Experiment: what was actually done and its reproducible evidence are recorded.
- [ ] Result: the observations and supported/not-supported/inconclusive outcome are recorded.
- [ ] Residue: limitations and concrete next steps for future PRs, or a justified stop, are recorded.
